title: Bob Wilson and Rick Wilson Join Zions Wealth in Boise
summary: The twin brothers bring more than 30 years of experience in the financial services industry to the positions, most recently as wealth advisors and market managers at ICCU.
body_markdown:
BOISE, Idaho — September 30, 2026 — Bob Wilson and Rick Wilson have joined Zions Wealth as senior vice presidents and wealth professionals and will be supported by client account service associates Jannet Sheehan and Heather Sullivan.


The team is based at Zions Bank’s Idaho headquarters at Eighth and Main in downtown Boise and will serve clients in Western and North Idaho and the Wood River Valley.


Rick and Bob, who are twin brothers, bring more than 30 years of experience in the financial services industry to the positions, most recently as wealth advisors and market managers at ICCU. As certified Chartered Retirement Planning Counselors, they specialize in building relationships with high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals, families and business owners, and have extensive experience serving complex client needs through a disciplined approach to wealth management practices.
